name: 12-week-year-kb
description: Plug-and-play AI agent knowledge base for the 12 Week Year execution system — organized by layer: agent (system prompt), rag (semantic recall), knowledge (vector DB)
source: The 12 Week Year by Brian P. Moran & Michael Lennington

structure.agent: System prompt — loaded at inference. Persona, rules, protocols, state management.
structure.rag: Semantic recall — trigger-based retrieval. Cheat sheets, emotional models, competitive landscape.
structure.knowledge: Vector DB — chunked & embedded. Domain content, templates, examples.

files.title: Agent Prompts
files.purpose: Copy-pasteable system prompts and weekly check-in scripts

files.title: Agent Index
files.purpose: Quick reference: ingestion order, rules, persona, escalation triggers, terminology

files.title: Execution Protocol
files.purpose: Agent operating manual: user journey, weekly check-in script, emergency protocol, tone

files.title: First Conversation Protocol
files.purpose: Step-by-step onboarding flow for new users

files.title: Troubleshooting
files.purpose: Tested responses to the 10 most common user objections

files.title: Between Cycles
files.purpose: Break week protocol and transition guidance from one 12-week cycle to the next

files.title: Agent State Management
files.purpose: Required JSON state structure and update rules for multi-week coaching

files.title: RAG Integration Guide
files.purpose: Instructions for embedding this KB into any RAG or vector database system
files.trigger: Developer configuring the agent's RAG infrastructure

files.title: Cheat Sheet
files.purpose: One-page quick reference for agents before weekly check-ins
files.trigger: Pre-check-in refresh; agent needs quick protocol reminder

files.title: Emotional Cycle
files.purpose: The 5 emotional zones of a 12-week cycle and agent playbook per zone
files.trigger: User reports motivation drop, low score, or is in weeks 3-9

files.title: The Emotional Cycle of Change (ECOC)
files.purpose: Kelley & Conner's 5-stage psychological model of voluntary behavior change (Uninformed Optimism → Valley of Despair → Success), with per-stage agent protocol
files.trigger: User enters Valley of Despair or asks 'why is this so hard?'

files.title: Competitive Landscape: Achieve App
files.purpose: Analysis of the official 12 Week Year app (Achieve) — capabilities, pricing tiers, strengths, weaknesses, differentiation strategy for competing agents
files.trigger: User asks about Achieve app or compares agent to official app

files.title: Core Concepts
files.purpose: Periodization, cycle structure, 3 principles, 5 disciplines, performance equation

files.title: Framework
files.purpose: Detailed breakdown of Accountability, Commitment, Greatness in the Moment

files.title: Vision
files.purpose: How to craft 3-year vision, brain-storming protocol, quality checks, pitfalls

files.title: Planning
files.purpose: Goal criteria, tactics breakdown, weekly planning ritual, agent checklist

files.title: Process Control
files.purpose: WAM, weekly planning, daily check, break week, process control tools

files.title: Measurement
files.purpose: Scorekeeping philosophy, weekly scorecard, score ranges, lead vs lag measures

files.title: Time Use
files.purpose: Time audit, strategic block, buffer block, breakout block, calendar template

files.title: Glossary
files.purpose: Alphabetical definitions of all 12-week-year terms

files.title: Tactic Design Rules
files.purpose: The 6 rules for bulletproof tactics, tactic types, count guidelines, redesigns

files.purpose: Reusable output structure for a complete 12-week plan

files.title: Weekly Plan Template
files.purpose: Reusable output structure for a single week's plan
